description: Kaspersky's Virus Removal Tool. Scan and disinfect an infected computer from viruses and other types of malicious programs.

checkver.script: $urls = @('https://devbuilds.s.kaspersky-labs.com/devbuilds/KVRT/latest/full/kvrt.xml', 'https://devbuilds.kaspersky-labs.com/devbuilds/KVRT/latest/full/kvrt.xml'); $errors = @(); foreach ($url in $urls) { for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 3; $attempt++) { try { $content = (Invoke-WebRequest $url -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'Mozilla/5.0' } -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -ErrorAction Stop).Content; if ($content -match 'version = "([\d.]+)"\r?\n\s{4}databases_timestamp = "([\d]+)"') { return "$($Matches[1]).$($Matches[2])" }; throw "Version metadata was not found in $url" } catch { $errors += "${url} attempt ${attempt}: $($_.Exception.Message)"; if ($attempt -lt 3) { Start-Sleep -Seconds (2 * $attempt) } } } }; throw "Unable to determine the latest KVRT build: $($errors -join '; ')"
